title: Bitcoin Price Falls Below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down and Strategy (MSTR) Slides
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Falls Below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down and Strategy (MSTR) Slides Bitcoin price fell below $72,000 on Thursday, its lowest level since mid-August, after Nvidia said CEO Jensen Huang had resigned and Strategy shares slid on MSCI's confirmed index exit. This post Bitcoin Price Falls Below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down and Strategy (MSTR) Slides first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
